license: ISC core validation subset after excluding GPLv2 tracker/HADES translation units
upstream_build_graph_note: The pinned upstream CMake graph lists GPLv2 saf_tracker sources in its unconditional core source list and GPLv2 tracker/HADES test files in the unit-test target even when those features are disabled. Aurora applies validation/open-immersive/saf-permissive-core.patch in CI so those translation units are absent from the validation build graph.
acceptance_model: semantic-and-geometric with a bounded alternative-triangulation outlier budget; sample-identical PCM or gain-identical triangulation is not required
truth_boundary: SAF is a pinned external software validation oracle only. Passing this lane does not make SAF an Aurora runtime dependency, does not validate the excluded GPL tracker/HADES modules, does not prove acoustic or physical-hardware behavior, and does not establish 11.1.4, binaural/HOA, proprietary immersive-renderer equivalence, or certification.
